 Judgment

The appeals are filed by the owner of the lorry bearing registration No.KA-25/7925 challenging the judgment and award dated 01.08.2012 passed by the Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal-IX,
Mudhol, in MVC No.722/2010, questioning the liability fixed on him.

entities.text:
Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal-IX,
Mudhol
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of the accident, death of the deceased are not disputed.
The only disputed fact is whether the insurance company is liable to indemnify and pay compensation or not.

3. Heard arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.
It is the case of the claimant that the deceased and other 25 persons were travelling in the truck for attending marriage function.
Therefore, being member of marriage party, the deceased and others were travelling in the truck and the said truck met with accident and NC: 2023:KHC-D:13271 deceased died.
This is reflected in Ex.P.1-complaint and Ex.P.2-FIR.
Ex.P.6 is the charge sheet in which it is stated that the deceased and others were travelling in the truck for attending a marriage function.
Therefore, it is proved that the truck is a goods carriage vehicle and for carrying passengers is not permitted.
But the deceased and others were travelling in the truck which is not meant for carrying any passengers/persons.
Therefore, there is violation of conditions of policy.
The deceased cannot be said that he is a third party, because the deceased was travelling in the truck.
Therefore, there is violation of conditions of insurance policy and also the deceased was not third party.
Hence, the insurance company is not liable to indemnify the owner and pay compensation.
Therefore, the owner alone shall pay compensation to the claimants.
Hence, the findings given by the tribunal is found to be correct which needs no interference.
Hence, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13271 ORDER i) Both the appeals filed by the owner of the lorry bearing registration No.KA-25/7925 are dismissed.
